svg.title: Outcome shift from A to B
svg.desc: Where do A's failures go under B, and B's under A? Of 307 tasks haiku ts-off failed, haiku ts-on passed 93; of 493 haiku ts-off passed, haiku ts-on failed 133.

g.text: Each shared task's outcome under A (left) and under B (right); ribbons carry groups of tasks and keep A's colour, so
a ribbon ending in another class is a task that changed.
